Marta (Onboard): Quick 7d health check for NovaTech — calling out usage/latency/spend. Sharing p95/p99 by route+model, streaming vs non-streaming. TL;DR: usage +8% w/w, spend +3%, small bump in error rate. streaming still best for chat-route latency but p99 tail on assistant-long-context is concerning.
Aisha (CS): thanks — can you paste the numbers?
Marta (Onboard): sure — raw 95/99 ms (approx) for last 7 days: 
```
chat-route (model: redwood-rlhf-v1): streaming p95=120 p99=420, non-stream p95=260 p99=980
assistant-long (model: redwood-rlhf-v1-extended): streaming p95=210 p99=1450, non-stream p95=440 p99=3200
embed-route (model: embed-lite): streaming p95=45 p99=120, non-stream p95=90 p99=260
rerank-route (model: cross-rank-1): streaming p95=85 p99=300, non-stream p95=160 p99=650
```
Tom (SE): interesting — assistant-long p99 jump on streaming looks bad. Any correlation with sequence length or batch size?
Ravi (Infra): checked traces — 70% of p99 spikes correlate with requests >8k tokens and also cache miss rate up. KV cache hit dropped ~6% last 7d.
Aisha (CS): error rate numbers? renewal risk?
Marta (Onboard): errors: 4xx ~0.18% (+0.03), 5xx ~0.07% (+0.02). Spend: $4.25k last 7d vs $4.12k prior. Usage: total requests +8%, avg tokens/request +4%. Renewal: customer still engaged, but mention of "latency for long docs" in last call — flagging as moderate risk if p99 not addressed.
Tom (SE): action items: 1) try aggressive KV cache TTL bump for assistant-long, 2) add a streaming-to-nonstream fallback for >6k token requests, 3) reduce batch size for long sequences during peak windows.
Aisha (CS): I'll offer a short enablement session to NovaTech next Tue to show streaming best practices + prompt engineering to reduce context size. @Tom can you join? :calendar:
Tom (SE): yep, I can.
Ravi (Infra): rolled a config patch last night to prefer quantized-variant on overflow — will monitor. LatencyBot: added p95/p99 charts to NovaTech dashboard and set an alert for assistant-long p99 > 1.2s.
LatencyBot: dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/nb/novaTech/latency?from=now-7d&to=now
Marta (Onboard): follow-ups: Aisha to run enablement, Tom to test fallback + cache tweaks, Ravi to validate KV-hit improvement and watch alert. Can we reconvene Fri EOD with numbers?
Aisha (CS): scheduled invite for Fri 16:00 PT. I'll capture customer feedback during the session.
Tom (SE): I'll push test changes to staging today — will post perf deltas here.
Ravi (Infra): monitoring window opened, will post KV hit + p99 snapshot by tomorrow morning.
Aisha (CS): note for renewal: mention that dedicated capacity or pinning model-variant reduces p99 variability. Good to surface as a recommendation in renewal playbook.
Marta (Onboard): thanks all. Quick note: customer requested sample traces for top 5 slow requests — @Tom @Ravi pls export and drop into shared drive. :thumbsup:
Tom (SE): will do.
Ravi (Infra): exported, link: https://files.redwood.ai/nova/slow-traces-3601234567.zip
Aisha (CS): copying this thread into the renewal doc. Good thread — will update scoreboard after Fri check-in. :white_check_mark:
